item.title: [SAMPLE] Cabinet approves draft amendment to the Bangladesh Labour Act
item.description: [SAMPLE] Cabinet gives final approval to the draft Bangladesh Labour (Amendment) Act; the bill will now be placed before parliament.

item.title: [SAMPLE] Bangladesh and Nepal sign MoU on hydropower trade
item.description: [SAMPLE] Dhaka and Kathmandu signed a memorandum of understanding allowing Bangladesh to import electricity from Nepal through the Indian grid under a tripartite arrangement.
